problem:
If
    $D=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & 7 & 4\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $D.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${D}^{T}=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-4}} |  |
worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{D}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ 7 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$
